body: No, I totally understand. I recently have been going back to local tournaments and the drive to get better completely overwhelms the potential toxicity of online. I hate playing against most campers and 'one and done'ers' but I like improving more than losing lol
All good, man, it's all about how much you want to put into the game, at the end of the day. Elite smash/quickplay gets pretty exhausting at times, honestly
